name: Magma Core

specialAbility.name: Meltdown
specialAbility.description: Overheats its molten engine to blast a wave of lava at the enemy — super powerful, but melts its own armor a little!

lore: Deep inside Magma Core's engine burns real liquid hot magma from an ancient volcano! When it revs up for its Meltdown attack, glowing lava oozes out of every crack and the ground sizzles beneath its tires. Sure, it gets a little toasty in there, but that's the price of being totally awesome!
